lesson.title: Tavo Mass Calculations

sections.title: Understanding Tavo Units
sections.content: Based on the provided reference material, a single tavo unit has a mass of 7 grams (Section 1). To find the total mass of multiple units, we multiply the number of units by the mass of one unit.

sections.title: Computing Mass for Four Units
sections.content:
To compute the mass of four tavo units, we use the following calculation based on Section 1:

4 units × 7 grams per unit = 28 grams.

The reference confirms that four units weigh 28 grams.

lesson.title: Equal Shares: Understanding One Half

sections.title: What is a Half?
sections.content: One half means splitting one thing into two equal pieces. When you split something into two equal pieces, each person gets one half. Equal means the pieces are the same size.

lesson.summary: A half is one of two equal parts of a whole. If a loaf of bread is split into two pieces that are the same size, each piece is one half.
discussion_questions: If you split a loaf of bread into two pieces and they are the same size, what does each person get?
objectives: Explain one half using simple words
lesson.content: One half means splitting one thing into two equal pieces. When you split something into two equal pieces, each person gets one half. Equal means the pieces are the same size.

[segment:1]
[section:1]

sections.title: What is a Sori Unit?
sections.content: A sori unit is a way to measure length. According to the text, one sori unit measures six centimetres (6 cm) [Section: 1].

sections.title: Calculating Five Units
sections.content:
To find the length of five units, we multiply the size of one unit by five.

Calculation:
6 cm + 6 cm + 6 cm + 6 cm + 6 cm = 30 cm
Or:
6 cm x 5 = 30 cm

The text states that five units measure thirty centimetres (30 cm) [Section: 1].

lesson.title: Understanding Half

sections.title: What is a Half?
sections.content: A half means making two groups that have the same number. For example, if you have one group and another group with the same amount, you have split the total into halves.

sections.title: Example: Seeds
sections.content: Imagine a jar holds eight seeds. To find half of these seeds, we make two groups with the same number. Half of eight seeds is four seeds (8 divided into 2 equal groups = 4).

lesson.summary: A half is when you split a total amount into two equal groups. In this lesson, we saw that half of eight seeds is four seeds.

exercises.explanation: According to the source data, there are six miko packs and each pack contains two shells. To find the total, you multiply 6 (packs) by 2 (shells per pack), which equals 12.
hints: Think about how many shells are in just one pack.
If one pack has 2 shells, how many would be in two packs?
Keep adding 2 for every pack until you count all six packs.
